abilities.effect: The vines wrap around the triggering creature. The creature must succeed at a DC 22 Reflex save or be grabbed until it Escapes (DC 22). Whether or not the creature is grabbed, the plants make a gnawing plants Strike against the creature.
abilities.name: Trapping Vines
abilities.trigger: A creature moves within reach of the carnivorous plants' vines

hazard.description: Many carnivorous plants that were once kept satiated now hunger for any meat they can get, even lashing out onto the path to get it.
hazard.disable: DC 25 Survival (trained) to distract or trick the plants or DC 22 Nature (expert) to calm the plants
hazard.name: Agitated Carnivorous Plants

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
